title: Senior Software Engineer II - Data Engineering and Platform
jobDescription:
LG Ad Solutions LG Ad Solutions is a global leader in connected TV (CTV) and cross-screen advertising. We pride ourselves on delivering state-of-the-art advertising solutions that integrate seamlessly with today's ever-evolving digital media landscape. The Opportunity: We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced developer to join our team in the role of Senior Software Engineer II – Data Engineering & Platform. This pivotal role focuses on providing technical vision and leadership for a major business component, managing end-to-end processes that operate at a high scale, processing several petabytes of data daily. The ideal candidate will have a robust background in data engineering, coupled with a proven track record in technical leadership. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to drive technical innovation and deliver robust, scalable solutions that meet our business needs.

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Architect and Implement Scalable Data Solutions: Design, develop, and deploy comprehensive data solutions encompassing ETL pipelines, data warehousing, data architecture, data cataloguing, and data delivery mechanisms. Ensure these solutions are scalable, reliable, and maintainable to support evolving business needs.​ Lead Data Platform Strategy: Develop and execute the strategic vision for the data platform, ensuring alignment with organizational objectives. Oversee the architecture and management of data systems to support efficient data storage, processing, and utilization.​ Collaborate Cross-Functionally: Work closely with product managers, engineering teams, data scientists, and other stakeholders to design and implement effective data integration and hand-off mechanisms. Facilitate seamless data flow and accessibility across various systems and teams.​ Optimize Performance and Scalability: Identify and address performance bottlenecks within the data platform. Implement strategies to enhance system performance, scalability, and reliability, ensuring the infrastructure can handle large-scale data processing efficiently.​ Oversee Data Governance and Quality: Implement and maintain data governance frameworks to ensure data quality, accuracy, consistency, and security. Establish policies and procedures for data management, ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements and industry best practices.​ Mentor and Lead Engineering Teams: Provide technical leadership and mentorship to data engineers and other team members. Foster a culture of innovation, ownership, and continuous learning within the team, guiding them through complex technical challenges and project deliveries.​ Conduct Code and Architecture Reviews: Lead code and architecture reviews to maintain high standards of code quality and system design. Provide constructive feedback and ensure adherence to best practices and organizational standards.​ Stay Abreast of Industry Trends: Keep up-to-date with emerging technologies, tools, and methodologies in data engineering and platform development. Evaluate and recommend new solutions to enhance the data platform's capabilities and efficiency. Requirements: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.​ Over 5 years of software development experience, with at least 2 years in a technical leadership role overseeing data engineering or data platform teams.​ Strong proficiency in big data technologies, including Apache Spark/Py Spark, Apache Airflow and Apache Kafka.​ Experience with programming languages such as Scala and Python for developing robust data pipelines.​ In-depth knowledge of both relational and non-relational databases, with the ability to design and optimize complex queries.​ Hands-on experience with data visualization tools and techniques to present data insights effectively.​ Proficiency in developing and maintaining CI/CD pipelines using tools like Jenkins and Git Hub Actions.​ Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Ia C) tools such as Pulumi and Terraform for managing cloud resources.​ Strong experience in writing and maintaining unit, integration, and end-to-end tests to ensure data pipeline reliability and accuracy.​ Excellent problem-solving abilities with a keen attention to detail, capable of diagnosing and resolving complex technical issues.​ Strong communication skills, with the ability to convey complex technical concepts to diverse audiences.​ Proven ability to collaborate cross-functionally with product managers, data scientists, and other engineering teams to deliver cohesive data solutions.​ Familiarity with data governance and security practices to ensure compliance and data integrity.​ Preferred: Prior experience working with Databricks and AWS cloud services.​ Experience with Agile development methodologies and leading Agile teams. Experience in working with Distributed Graph Databases. title: Security Engineer

You will be working with EDR, MDR, network security tools, SIEM, phishing simulations, email security, application security and help in compliance related tasks. We are looking for someone with a background in cloud environment who can help in improving security in AWS. This role will report directly to Senior Security Engineer II.

Implement NIST and CIS guidelines within LG Ads infrastructure. ● Stay up-to-date on changes to relevant cybersecurity regulations and standards, and communicate those changes to stakeholders. ● Review and support SAST/DAST findings—help engineering teams interpret issues, validate false positives, dismiss findings when appropriate, and guide remediation. ● Contribute to the development of metrics and reporting mechanisms to track supply chain cybersecurity performance. Requirements: ● Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, or related field, or equivalent practical experience. ● 5+ years of experience in security engineering, vulnerability management, or security operations. ● 3+ years experience with SIEM platforms (e.g., Splunk, Sentinel) and EDR tools such as Crowd Strike or equivalent. ● Strong hands-on experience with Linux systems (hardening, troubleshooting, log analysis, scripting). ● Solid understanding of cloud security, especially AWS (IAM, VPC, EC2, S3, security groups, logging, etc.). ● Familiarity with SAST/DAST tools and workflows, including triage, false-positive validation, and supporting developers. ● Strong understanding of cyber threat landscapes, attack vectors, and mitigation techniques. ● Strong understanding of common attack vectors, exploitation techniques, mitigation strategies and secure coding practices. ● Experience working with security frameworks such as NIST, CIS Controls, SOC 2, or ISO
27001. ● Proven ability to collaborate with engineering teams and drive remediation efforts to closure. ● Strong problem-solving, communication, and cross-functional collaboration skills. ● Willingness to participate in on-call rotation for security incidents. Preferred: ● Hands-on experience with Crowdstrike (SIEM, EDR), AWS security services (e.g., Guard Duty, Security Hub, IAM Access Analyzer, Firewalls, etc.). ● Experience with infrastructure-as-code and policy-as-code (e.g., Terraform, Cloud Formation), previous work with Dev Sec Ops. ● Scripting/automation skills (Python, Bash, etc.) for remediation and security tooling. ● Experience with threat modeling, security architecture reviews and application security tools (SAST, DAST, etc.) ● Relevant certifications (e.g., GCIH, GCIA, GCLD, GCPN, AWS Security Specialty ). ● Understanding of AI-driven or ML-based security tools. ● Hands on incident response experience with Linux. title: Software Engineer II, Data Engineer
jobDescription:
LG Ad Solutions LG Ad Solutions is a global leader in connected TV (CTV) and cross-screen advertising. We pride ourselves on delivering state-of-the-art advertising solutions that integrate seamlessly with today's ever-evolving digital media landscape. The Opportunity: We are looking for a highly driven Software Engineer 2 to join our Data & Platform Engineering team at LG Ad Solutions. In this role, your primary focus will be designing, building, and scaling robust, Terabyte-scale data pipelines that power our core advertising (DSP/SSP) and Automatic Content Recognition (ACR) systems. Beyond just moving data, you will be instrumental in developing essential Data Platform-related tooling, establishing rigorous Data Governance frameworks, and ensuring strict Data Compliance across our massive data ecosystem. This role is designed for an engineer who thrives on ownership, possesses strong computer science fundamentals, and is ready to tackle the complex distributed systems challenges inherent in managing high-velocity, high-volume data that directly impacts company revenue.

RESPONSIBILITIES:
System Ownership: Build and maintain a comprehensive understanding across multiple complex data pipelines and platform projects owned by the team. Core Data Engineering: Design, develop, test, and deploy robust backend services and data pipelines processing Terabytes of Ad Tech and ACR data. Platform & Governance: Build and maintain internal platform tooling to enforce strict Data Governance, Data Quality, and Data Compliance standards across all data assets. Task Definition & Scoping: Autonomously define the scope, technical enhancements, and deliverables for features of limited complexity, and provide accurate time estimates. Feature Set Contribution: Effectively contribute to the planning and development of features affecting multiple components across our data ecosystem with minimal guidance. Advanced Debugging: Independently troubleshoot, debug, and resolve somewhat complex bugs within distributed environments and massive-scale data processing workflows. Technical Communication: Comprehend and clearly communicate complex technical concepts—including technical designs, system architecture, and key engineering decisions—to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Global Collaboration: Work closely with product managers, data scientists, and engineering counterparts in the US and India (requiring overlap with US time zones, typically aligning with core hours of 8 AM
- 11 AM MST). Requirements: Bachelor's Degree ( B.Tech/B.E .) in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field. 2+ years of relevant professional software development experience, with a strong preference for Backend or Data Engineering roles. Strong proficiency in Data Structures and Algorithms. Solid understanding of core Computer Science concepts, specifically Operating Systems, Computer Networks, and DBMS. Exceptional problem-solving and analytical skills, with a proactive, self-starter attitude. Clear and effective communication of technical challenges, both verbally and in writing. Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively across time zones. Preferred: Experience with Big Data processing frameworks, specifically Apache Spark (Py Spark or Scala-Spark). Hands-on experience with modern data platforms like Databricks and orchestration tools like Apache Airflow. Experience building, maintaining, and scaling complex ETL processes. Familiarity with cloud computing platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and related infrastructure. Understanding of distributed systems concepts and proficiency in Low-Level Design (LLD). Why Join Us? High Impact: Work on systems critical to the company's revenue stream—our team touches every single dollar this company makes. Cutting-Edge Exposure: Gain hands-on experience with massive-scale data processing for advanced Ad Tech (DSP, SSP) and state-of-the-art ACR systems. Modern Tech Stack: Utilize and master highly sought-after technologies within the Big Data and backend ecosystem (Spark, Python, Databricks, AWS, Monte Carlo, Datahub, Cloud platforms). Strong Ownership Culture: We empower engineers to take initiative, own features end-to-end, and drive results independently. Growth Opportunity: Join a high-growth company offering significant learning potential, mentorship from experienced engineers, and clear pathways for career progression towards senior roles. title: Director, Quality Assurance
jobDescription: LG Ad Solutions LG Ad Solutions is a global leader in connected TV and cross-screen advertising. We deliver innovative advertising solutions that integrate seamlessly with today’s evolving digital media landscape. The Opportunity As the Director of Quality Assurance at LG Ad Solutions, you will lead and scale the organization’s quality engineering strategy across multiple products, platforms and global delivery teams. This role is responsible for defining and executing the long-term QA vision, driving enterprise-wide quality initiatives and ensuring the delivery of highly reliable, scalable and performant products. The Director of QA will provide strategic leadership across software quality, test automation, release readiness and quality engineering transformation while partnering closely with Product, Engineering, Dev Ops, Infrastructure and Executive Leadership. This role requires a strong people leader and technical strategist with proven experience leading large QA organizations, influencing cross-functional stakeholders and driving measurable quality improvements across complex distributed systems. You will champion a culture of quality throughout the organization, modernize testing practices, improve operational excellence and help establish quality engineering as a critical business enabler. Responsibilities Organizational Leadership & Strategy ● Define and execute the organization-wide QA and Quality Engineering strategy aligned with business objectives, engineering goals and product roadmaps. ● Lead, mentor and grow a high-performing global QA organization across multiple teams, programs and delivery streams. ● Establish departmental KPIs, operational objectives and quality metrics to measure product quality, release readiness, automation effectiveness and engineering efficiency. ● Drive enterprise-wide quality initiatives including test automation modernization, shift-left testing, CI/CD quality integration and scalable test strategies. ● Partner with senior leadership to prioritize investments, staffing and process improvements that improve product quality and engineering velocity. ● Serve as the primary QA leader and escalation point for major quality initiatives, risks and production-impacting issues. ● Build and maintain a culture of accountability, innovation, operational excellence and continuous improvement. ● Lead organizational change management efforts related to quality engineering practices, tooling and processes. ● Develop succession planning, career growth frameworks and mentorship programs for QA leadership and engineering staff. Team Management & Delivery Excellence ● Oversee QA planning, execution and delivery across multiple simultaneous programs ensuring alignment with organizational priorities and timelines. ● Ensure products are released with high standards of reliability, scalability, performance and usability. ● Provide executive-level communication regarding quality risks, release readiness, operational impacts and mitigation strategies. ● Drive cross-functional alignment between QA, Engineering, Product Management, PMO, Dev Ops and Operations. ● Improve organizational efficiency through optimized test planning, automation strategy, resource allocation and quality governance. ● Lead hiring efforts and attract top-tier QA and Quality Engineering talent. ● Foster collaboration, transparency and accountability across geographically distributed teams. Quality Engineering & Process Excellence ● Drive large-scale adoption of automated testing frameworks and modern quality engineering practices. ● Champion quality automation strategies across UI, API, integration, data and infrastructure testing. ● Oversee implementation and governance of enterprise QA tooling, frameworks and reporting systems. ● Establish quality gates and automated validation within CI/CD pipelines. ● Improve production stability by reducing defect escape rates and driving preventative quality practices. ● Lead post-release quality reviews and operational RCA initiatives. ● Evaluate emerging technologies, AI/ML-driven testing approaches and automation innovations to improve efficiency, coverage and defect detection. ● Define and lead the organization’s AI-enabled Quality Engineering strategy including leveraging AI-assisted test generation, intelligent test optimization, predictive defect analysis, autonomous testing approaches and AI-powered quality insights to improve engineering velocity and product reliability. ● Drive adoption of AI tools and workflows across the QA organization to improve productivity, accelerate release validation, enhance root cause analysis and optimize test coverage. ● Ensure effective management of test environments, test data and release validation processes. Cross-Functional Collaboration & Executive Influence ● Act as a strategic advisor to Engineering and Product leadership on quality-related risks, priorities and operational improvements. ● Influence organizational decisions and engineering practices to ensure quality is embedded throughout product development. ● Partner closely with Dev Ops and Infrastructure teams to strengthen observability, release quality and deployment reliability. ● Facilitate alignment between technical and non-technical stakeholders by communicating quality strategies, tradeoffs and outcomes clearly. ● Represent the QA organization in executive meetings, roadmap discussions and operational reviews. ● Promote customer-focused quality practices by incorporating end-user feedback and production insights into quality initiatives. Requirements ● 12+ years of Quality Assurance and/or Quality Engineering experience including 7+ years in senior leadership or management roles. ● Proven experience leading enterprise QA organizations across multiple products, platforms and engineering teams. ● Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering or equivalent practical experience. Advanced degrees are a plus. ● Deep understanding of modern SDLC methodologies including Agile, Dev Ops and CI/CD. ● Strong expertise in QA methodologies, software testing strategies, automation frameworks and release management practices. ● Demonstrated success building and scaling enterprise-grade QA and Quality Engineering organizations. ● Experience defining organizational quality strategy, metrics, governance and operational excellence programs. ● Strong hands-on experience with modern automation frameworks and tools including Playwright, Selenium, Cypress, Test NG or equivalent. ● Experience with API testing, performance testing and security testing methodologies and tooling. ● Strong understanding of hybrid architectures and platforms including AWS and on-prem Datacenters. ● Experience integrating automated testing into CI/CD pipelines using tools such as Jenkins, Git Hub Actions, Git Lab CI or equivalent. ● Strong experience with modern engineering and QA tools such as JIRA, Practitest, Postman, and related platforms. ● Experience with version control systems such as Git/Git Hub/Git Lab. ● Strong strategic thinking, analytical and problem-solving abilities. ● Proven ability to influence senior stakeholders and drive organizational change. ● Exceptional written and verbal communication skills with the ability to communicate effectively to technical and executive audiences. ● Strong leadership presence, negotiation skills and executive-level presentation capabilities. ● Experience operating effectively in fast-paced, high-growth environments. ● Strong quality mindset with exceptional attention to detail and operational rigor. Preferred ● Experience within OEM (Original Equipment Manufacturer), Consumer Electronics, digital advertising, Ad Tech, media or related technology industries. ● Advanced QA certifications such as CSQE, ISTQB Advanced or equivalent. ● Experience architecting enterprise-level automation frameworks including data-driven, keyword-driven and hybrid testing frameworks. ● Experience with service virtualization concepts and tooling. ● Experience building testing frameworks for SDKs and distributed systems. ● Advanced performance engineering expertise using tools such as Load Runner, JMeter, Neo Load, Locust or equivalent. ● Experience implementing AI/ML-driven quality engineering, intelligent testing approaches and AI-assisted automation strategies. ● Strong understanding of emerging AI technologies and practical applications of generative AI within software testing, automation, quality analytics and engineering productivity workflows. ● Experience evaluating and integrating AI-powered QA tools for test case generation, defect prediction, test optimization, observability and release quality analysis. ● Strong programming/scripting expertise in Java Script (Node.js), Python and/or Java. ● Experience managing globally distributed QA organizations and offshore teams. ● Experience driving large-scale QA transformation initiatives and operational maturity programs.
